TriCell

What it is

A three-cell oxygen analyzer project, from bench electronics to printed housings and custom hardware.

TriCell is an ongoing development project exploring a three-sensor oxygen analyzer. Follow the workshop log for build notes, housing iterations, and future updates.

Development updates will appear in the workshop log.

Development prototype. Not offered as a validated diving instrument or for underwater life-support use.
